0022600203.text: Atlanta hosts the Los Angeles Lakers with the Hawks at 7-4, 3-2 at home, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, and riding a four-game win streak after going 6-4 over their last ten. The Lakers arrive at 8-2, first in the Pacific and third in the West, with an 8-2 record over their last ten and a four-game streak of their own, though Luka Doncic is out with back soreness. Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Hawks' last meeting was a 141-116 loss in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
